coverage: Ordinary openings of Settings, History, General Gallery, Player Guide and New Game Setup focus within the current surface; ordinary closing of each restores exact reference equality to the original enabled confirmation button.

All five panels are opened with visibility bindings applied at DataBind but Input callbacks pending. A real non-default action is focused and exact actual Keyboard.FocusedElement is unchanged after the callback.
All five panels are closed with Input callbacks pending. A real currently selected candidate is newly focused; exact candidate focus is unchanged after the callback.
Every five-panel opening/closing race preserves the actual command-session revision and CreateSnapshot(0).
The motion toggle first receives real keyboard focus, then becomes disabled before the pending callback. Focus recovers to the enabled sound toggle; the local disabled value is cleared in finally.
